user.title: Spa WebSocket
user.description: Connect to your spa's WebSocket endpoint. The BT-200 (a /wsa/ URL) is the better one to drive: it takes the setpoint on the socket and shows it back on the panel's own display.

data_description.fallback_url: The spa's other module, tried only when a write fails on the first. Both reach the spa through the same relay, so this is not a second path to it -- it covers one module dropping off the cloud while the other stays up.

reconfigure.title: Spa WebSocket
reconfigure.description: Point this spa at a different URL. Use this when the token changes, or to switch which module the integration drives.

data_description.fallback_url: The spa's other module, tried only when a write fails on the first. Both reach the spa through the same relay, so this is not a second path to it -- it covers one module dropping off the cloud while the other stays up.

error.invalid_url: The URL must start with ws:// or wss://.
error.same_url: The second URL has to be a different module, not the same one again.
error.url_in_use: Another spa entry already uses that URL. Each entry's identity is its URL, so two cannot share one.

abort.already_configured: This spa URL is already configured.
